title: Human Computer Interface (HCI) in Everyday Life

items.title: Lesson Podcast
items.description: Audio walkthrough of HCI — its six application areas and how hardware, software and interaction methods shape design.

items.title: How computers learn to recognize objects instantly — Joseph Redmon TED
items.description: A TED talk on computer vision — how machines interpret human input through image recognition, directly linked to HCI.

items.title: 100+ Computer Science Concepts Explained — Fireship
items.description: Covers input/output concepts and interaction models — great background for understanding what makes a good HCI design.

items.title: The ethical dilemma of self-driving cars — Patrick Lin TED
items.description: Explores human-machine interaction in safety-critical systems — a real-world HCI application area (transport).

items.title: Ex Machina (2015)
items.description: A sci-fi thriller where a programmer evaluates an AI's human-like interface — raises deep questions about HCI and machine intelligence.

items.title: OCR Cambridge Nationals IT — Specification at a Glance
items.description: Official OCR J836 spec — check the HCI section to know exactly which application areas you need for the exam.

items.title: Seneca Learning — Free Revision
items.description: Reinforce HCI concepts with interactive practice questions on Seneca's free revision platform.
